title: Statistical Analysis of Cell-Based Assays
text: microscopy-based cell assay, treatment condition measured across several wells, well contains many individual cells. Cells independent: fluorescence correlated within well (shared staining, focus, exposure). Treating every cell independent replicate inflates sample size gives optimistic p-values. cellreportR supports two standard resolutions: Cell-level tests treat cell data point. Use distributional comparisons (e.g. subpopulation shift). Replicate-level tests aggregate cells one number per well, test wells. Use primary inference whether compound effect. defensible workflow run report effect size CI alongside p-values replicate level.

title: cellreportR 0.1.0
text: cellreportR provides end--end analysis reporting pipeline cell-culture microscopy assays, picking cell segmentation (e.g. segmantR, CellProfiler, QuPath) leaves .

title: cellreportR 0.1.0
text: Import: cr_read_cells(), cr_read_design(), cr_read_cellprofiler(), cr_read_qupath(), cr_read_segmantr(), cr_build_experiment(), cr_validate_experiment(). Quality control: cr_qc_filter(), cr_qc_doublets(), cr_qc_intensity(), cr_qc_manual(), cr_qc_summary(). Normalization: cr_normalize(), cr_background_subtract(), cr_correct_batch(). Quantification: cr_summarize_wells(), cr_fold_change(), cr_compute_metrics(). Statistical testing: cr_test(), cr_test_all(), cr_effect_size(), cr_power_analysis() — hierarchical tests cell replicate level effect sizes. Discriminability: cr_logistic(), cr_roc(), cr_auc(), cr_confusion_matrix(). Dose-response: cr_dose_response() (4PL / 3PL / linear), cr_ic50(). Visualization: thirteen cr_plot_* functions covering plate layouts, distributions, scatter plots, fold-change effect-size forest plots, ROC curves, dose-response, QC dashboards, spatial plots, heatmaps time courses. Reporting: cr_report(), cr_export_results(), cr_export_plots(). Interactive: cr_run_app() launches seven-tab Shiny application. Example data: cr_example_experiment(), cr_example_design(), cr_example_files(). Utilities: cr_well_to_rowcol(), cr_rowcol_to_well(), cr_channels(), cr_n_cells(), cr_filter_cells(), cr_merge_experiments().
